# csgg

> csgg is a free online CS2 (Counter-Strike 2) strat planner and tactics board. Players, in-game leaders (IGLs), coaches and FACEIT or league teams use it to plan executes, retakes and setups on 2D radar maps, time every grenade, and share the plan with teammates in one link. No account is needed.

## What it does
- Maps: all CS2 Active Duty maps (Mirage, Dust II, Inferno, Nuke upper level, Ancient, Anubis, Train, Overpass) on Valve's radar overviews, plus a blank board.
- Objects: teammates and enemies (numbered 1-5 with roles), movement routes, smokes, flashes, molotovs, HE grenades, the C4, sight cones (wide, normal, narrow), pen drawings (freehand, lines, arrows, rectangles, dashed), text notes and lineup pins linking to a YouTube video or image.
- Timing: every route and grenade has a time; playback runs on a 1:55 round clock.
- Steps: a strat can have several steps (for example default, execute, post-plant); a new step can start where players ended the previous one.
- Sharing: the whole strat is stored in the share link; teammates open it without an account and can save their own copy.
- Saving: strats are saved automatically in the browser on the device they were made on.

## Facts
- Price: free.
- Platform: web browser; editing works best on a computer, viewing works on phones.
- Not affiliated with Valve. Map radar images are © Valve Corporation.
